sn3.17:1.3: Ekam antam nisinno kho rājā Pasenadi-kosalo Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn3.17:1.4: Atthi nu kho bhante eko dhammo yo ubho atthe samadhiggayha tiṭṭhati
sn3.17:1.5: diṭṭhadhammikaṃ c-eva atthaṃ samparāyikaṃ cā ti || || 3.
sn3.17:2.1: Atthi kho mahārāja eko dhammo yo ubho samadhiggayha tiṭṭhati
sn3.17:2.2: diṭṭhadhammikaṃ c-eva atthaṃ samparāyikaṃ cā ti || || 4.
sn3.17:3.1: Katamo pana bhante eko dhammo yo ubho atthe samadhiggayha tiṭṭhati
sn3.17:3.2: diṭṭhadhammikaṃ c-eva atthaṃ samparāyikaṃ cā ti || || 5.
sn3.17:4.1: Appamādo kho mahārāja eko dhammo ubho atthe samadhigghayha tiṭṭhati
sn3.17:4.2: diṭṭhadhammikaṃ c-eva atthaṃ samparāyikaṃ cā ti || ||
sn3.17:4.3: Seyyathāpi mahārāja yāni kānici jaṅgamānam pāṇānam padajatāni sabbāni tāni hatthipade samodhānaṃ gacchanti || hatthipadaṃ tesam aggam akkhāyati yad idam mahantena ||
sn3.17:4.4: evam eva kho mahārāja eko dhammo ubho atthe samadhiggayha tiṭṭhati
sn3.17:7.4: paṇḍito ti pavuccatīti || || 1. Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati || || 2. Ekam antam nisīdi || Ekam antaṃ
